# TextFormatBar

**Class:** `UltraCanvasTextFormatBar` · **Group:** [Text entry](../Groups/Text-entry.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTextFormatBar.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTextFormatBar.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasTextFormatBar.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

The **text formatting bar** over text the user sets — Font (every installed family, each shown in itself), Size, Bold, Italic, Underline, Strikethrough, alignment, line and letter spacing; reports each change, helpers for an `UltraCanvasRichTextEdit` typed on a canvas ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTextFormatBar.md))

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasTextFormatBar](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTextFormatBar.md)
- [UltraCanvasDropDownExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasDropDownExamples.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTextFormatBar> CreateTextFormatBar(const std::string& identifier, float height = 50.0f);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
explicit UltraCanvasTextFormatBar(const std::string& identifier, float height = 50.0f);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onFormatChanged` | `std::function<void(TextFormatAttribute attribute, const TextFormat& format)> onFormatChanged` | An attribute was changed by the user; `format` is the whole new format. |
| `onControlDone` | `std::function<void()> onControlDone` | A control of the bar has finished with the keyboard (a choice made, a list closed, a field left): a host typing a text gives it back to the text. Called after the event, as a list reports its closing from inside the event that closed it. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

Everything that configures the element: appearance, behaviour and content.

| Member | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `SetFormat` | `void SetFormat(const TextFormat& format)` | Shows a format; no onFormatChanged. |

| `SetSizeUnit` | `void SetSizeUnit(const std::string& suffix, double minimum, double maximum, int decimals, double step)` | The size field's unit, range, decimals and arrow step; letter spacing takes the same unit unless SetLetterSpacingUnit gives it its own. |

## Other methods

| Member | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `RefreshFonts` | `void RefreshFonts()` | The Font list again from the fonts installed now (one installed meanwhile joins it). Each family is shown in itself; the list prepares those previews in idle slices once the bar is on screen. The bar does this itself when the fonts the text engine knows change (GetFontSetGeneration) - the system fonts that arrive … |
| `InvalidateLayout` | `void InvalidateLayout() override` | Laid out again: the window does this to every element after the fonts changed, and the bar then makes its Font list again. |
| `ApplyTheme` | `void ApplyTheme(const UltraCanvasTheme& theme) override` | The bar's ground, ink and controls from a theme (a dark program's bar is dark; the icons take the ink). |
